title: Six Days on an Island
statement:
London, May 2019.
I was walking along the streets of this great city as a stranger, an observer. Small details, gestures and strange moments reveal to me the hidden face beneath the shiny mask of this urban city. Loneliness, boredom, melancholy and uncertainty – you can sometimes find them, if you look closely enough. The streets of this self-sufficient city are like a surreal island... In London’s public spaces you can find the magic and mystery of human beings. And if you have enough patience and a compassionate eye, Providence will reveal something deep and unseen about their souls.
